subject: Amendment Required to Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference, and found a few discrepancies that need your attention.
Specifically, for the Consignee, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.
Additionally, for the Notify Party, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, while the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.
Please amend the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction in all respects.
We look forward to receiving the updated draft.

Shipping Operations
